description: React component for managing and displaying groups of teams and channels in the Mattermost admin console, including collapse/expand functionality, role management, and rendering a table of team/channel entries.

classes.name: GroupTeamsAndChannels
classes.description: React component class for displaying and managing group teams and channels in the admin console.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with an empty collapsed record.

methods.name: onToggleCollapse
methods.description: Toggles the collapsed state of a team or channel by its ID.

methods.name: onRemoveItem
methods.description: Calls the external onRemoveItem handler with the given ID and type.

methods.name: onChangeRoles
methods.description: Calls the external onChangeRoles handler with the given ID, type, and role status.

methods.name: teamsAndChannelsToEntries
methods.description: Converts teams and channels data into a sorted list of entries for rendering.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI, including loading state, empty state, and the table of team/channel entries.
